title: Record the tmux pane id in the activity record
action: The activity record stores which pane a session runs in. At `hooks/activity.rs:257` — `if let Some(pane) = std::env::var("HERDR_PANE_ID").ok().filter(|p| !p.trim().is_empty()) {` — the pane field is written only for herdr. Extract a pure `fn pane_from_env(lookup: impl Fn(&str) -> Option<String>) -> Option<(String, String)>` returning `("herdr", id)` from `HERDR_PANE_ID` when non-empty, else `("tmux", id)` from `TMUX_PANE` when non-empty, else None; write `pane` as before and one additive key `pane_transport` with the first tuple slot. This is identity recording, not transport selection, so it does not read config and does not violate D1 — state that in a one-line comment. Tests ride the cell (names prefixed `activity_`): herdr wins when both are set; tmux when only TMUX_PANE; None when neither; empty strings count as unset. Check `docs/knowledge/areas/hook-runtime/agent-activity-record.md` for the field list and add `pane_transport` to it if the page enumerates fields (docs edit rides this cell only if that page lists `pane`; otherwise leave docs to tht-6).

truths: Inside a tmux pane (TMUX_PANE=%5, no HERDR_PANE_ID) the activity record carries pane %5 and pane_transport tmux
Inside herdr the record is unchanged except the additive pane_transport herdr
key_links: the activity writer at activity.rs:257 calls pane_from_env
prohibitions: No config read in the hook
No change to the state-transition logic
